verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes first-party client SDK source on GitHub (tavily-ai/tavily-python), so some of its code is publicly readable. However, the core hosted search, extract, crawl and research service is a closed API, and no evidence states which license the SDK uses. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g. MIT or Apache) for the SDK, open source for the core search/extract/crawl service, and evidence that the JavaScript SDK, MCP server or CLI source is public.
